description: Defines a mutable version of ColumnarRow used in Spark's vectorized execution engine for hash map and batch object management.

classes.name: MutableColumnarRow
classes.description: A mutable, in-memory representation of a row in a columnar batch, used for efficient data manipulation in Spark SQL's vectorized engine.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the current row, copying all fields.

methods.description: Not supported; throws exception.
